<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.dti = null) then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly = null or application.income.grossMonthly <= 0 then null else ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(concatenate([0], for d in application.debts return (if d.include = false then 0 else if d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else if application.loan.amount = null or application.collateral.appraisedValue = null or application.collateral.appraisedValue <= 0 then null else if application.purpose = "purchase" and not(application.collateral.purchasePrice = null) and application.collateral.purchasePrice > 0 then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: Precedence_Rule1_Over_Rule2
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (low credit) should take precedence over Rule 2 (fixed preference).

testSuite.name: Precedence_Rule1_Over_Rule3
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (high LTV) should take precedence over Rule 3 (ARM conditions).

testSuite.name: NoMatch_NullLTV
testSuite.description: LTV is null, so Rule 1 and Rule 3 cannot trigger.

testSuite.name: Boundary_Rule1_Credit640
testSuite.description: Credit score 640 is not < 640, so Rule 1 doesn't trigger. Rule 2 triggers due to preference.

testSuite.name: Boundary_Rule1_DTI50
testSuite.description: DTI 50 is not > 50, so Rule 1 doesn't trigger. Rule 2 triggers due to preference.

testSuite.name: ARM71_Fails_Stability
testSuite.description: Income stability is variable, failing Rule 3.

dmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income = null or application.income.grossMonthly = null or application.income.grossMonthly = 0 then null else ((if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0) + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts = null or count(application.debts) = 0 then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.loan = null or application.loan.amount = null or application.collateral = null then null else if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else if application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
